Equivalent to OpenCode `/execute-slice`.

Input: `BE-00X`, `FE-00X`, or `QA-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Orchestrator`.

Before acting, read:

- `docs/opencode/14_github_copilot_agentic_flow.md`
